title: County acquires Jackson Lakes for future park
description: Escambia County purchases the Jackson Lakes property, building on earlier public discussions about restoring Bayou Chico and creating a public waterfront park. The acquisition sets the stage for long-term plans focused on environmental restoration, stormwater management, and public access.

images.alt: Front page of the Pensacola News Journal dated April 28, 1998, featuring the headline “Park plan revives Bayou Chico” with a large photo of Jackson Lakes and a conceptual site plan for public access and restoration.
images.caption: In an April 28, 1998, Pensacola News Journal story titled “Park plan revives Bayou Chico,” county officials and planners outline ideas for transforming the Jackson Lakes area into a public park with environmental restoration and public access—plans that would be realized when Escambia County purchased the property in 2000.
